the place.\pWho knows, I may even get to battle
you one day, {PLAYER}.\pNext time, let's meet at a place
of battle!
name: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks2

t:
Hello, {PLAYER}…
I'm sorry to bug you, but I'm hopeless…\pEven when…
Even when I win, I don't have anything\lspecial to say…\pI know that it doesn't mean anything
to you, {PLAYER}.\pBut it means a lot to me…\pPlease, {PLAYER}, what should I say
if I win a battle?
name: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech3

t:
{STR_VAR_1}\pThat's inspired…\pUh… Is it okay for someone like me
to even say that?\pNo! I'll do my best!\p{PLAYER}, thank you so much for
putting up with me for so long…\pI promise to do my best from now on.\pI'm sure you'll quickly forget about
someone like me, but let's meet\lsomewhere again!
name: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks3

t:
Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
There's something I want you to hear.\pI know that I don't always sound
nice or polite…\pWhen I win a battle, I think I come
across as being arrogant.\pI don't want people to dislike me,
so I want to say something nice to\lsomeone I beat.\pBut I can't think of anything good!
Could you think something up for me?
name: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech4

t:
{STR_VAR_1}\pNot bad!
Yup, that's what I'll go with!\pI'm going to hit the road and do what
I can with what you taught me in\lmy head and heart.\pI'm sorry that I've been so pushy
with you!\pNext time, we battle, okay?
See you!
name: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks4

t:
Oh, I can't get over how busy I am!
Oh, hey, I was looking for you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pAre you well as usual?
Things haven't changed for me at all.\pI've got running, fighting, and mapping
to do. Why am I so busy?\pBut even though I'm busy, it'd be rude
to just turn on my heels and walk away\lfrom a win without saying a word.\pSo, what would be a cool saying to
underline my coolness when I'm done\land walking away? {PLAYER}{KUN}, help me!
name: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech5

t:
{STR_VAR_1}\pOkay, gotcha.
I can find time to say that!\pHonestly, I'm glad I met a good mentor
like you.\pI'm going to make time somehow so
I can get into battling.\pThanks for everything, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
We have to battle, you and me, one day!
name: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks5

t:
I lucked out again!
{PLAYER}! Am I glad to see you!\lLike usual, I need your advice!\pDrum roll, please!
The last question I have is…\pIf I win a battle and want to end
it with a cool flourish, what\lshould I say?
name: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech6

t:
{STR_VAR_1}\pThat… That's fabulous!
It's dignified and cool! I claim it!\p…Listen, I think I'm getting decent
at this, huh?\pSo, I'm thinking of challenging other
Trainers from now on.\p{PLAYER}, your advice really helped me.\pMaybe one day, there'll be a time when
we battle!\pThank you for everything!
name: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks6

t:
Oh, {PLAYER}.
I'm so glad I met you!\pI no longer have any concerns with
regard to my Pokémon.\pIt's myself that worries me…\pDo you know how a Trainer says
a few things upon winning a battle?\pDefinitely, I wish I could do that,
too!\pPlease, what should I say when
I win a battle?
name: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech7

t:
{STR_VAR_1}\pAh! That saying! It refreshes me
and makes me feel reborn!\pI must use that right away!\pAnd now, I must take my leave,
{PLAYER}…\pI will go out to battle many others,
but never will I forget your teachings.\pPerhaps one day…
Farewell!
name: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks7

t:
Eek! I spotted {PLAYER}!
I… I'm overjoyed to see you!\pOh-oh-oh! There's something I just
had to ask you!\pA little while ago, I won a battle.
That part was giddying!\pBut it made me so overjoyed that
I choked up and couldn't say a thing!\pSo now, {PLAYER}, please, I want you to
think up an exit line for when I win!
name: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech8

t:
{STR_VAR_1}\pWaaaaah!
I'm going to say that?!\lI… I'm delirious with joy!\pTh-th-thank you!
I have nothing left to regret now!\pI'm going to travel now and battle
all sorts of people.\pEverything, I owe it to you, {PLAYER}.
Really, really, thank you!\pI've got to go now, but let's meet
in battle one day!
name: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks8

t:
Hola, bueno!
{PLAYER}{KUN}!\pYou know, I'm getting the itch to roam
and battle where I may.\pBut before I do, I want your advice
once again, please!\pIf I were to win a battle, what would
be a good boast I could say to my\lfallen Trainer opponent?
name: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech9

t:
{STR_VAR_1}\pUh-huh, that's sweet!
Si, bueno!\lI'll try saying that, like, ham!\pAnd now, it's time to say good-bye!
Thanks for all sorts of things!\pGive me a battle one day, OK?
Adios!
name: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks9

t:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, there's big trouble!\pWhen I win a battle, I brag about it
for an hour at least!\pOf course I'm lying!
Wahahaha!\pThis is no lie, though.
I'm not very good at chatting.\pSo, how about deciding for me what
I should say after winning a battle,\lmaster?
name: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech10

t:
{STR_VAR_1}\pThat's what I should say, huh?
Then, I'll stay away from that!\pJust kidding!
I'll obey your teaching, master!\pThanks for teaching me all this time,
master!\pI'm finally understanding what being
a Trainer is about.\pI'm going to go out and win battles
against any Trainer.\pMaybe it'll be you one day, master!\pThat's all!
Farewell, my master!
name: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10

t:
A-H-O-Y!
And that spells ahoy!\pThe rappin' Sailor am I!
This will be my last question,\ldon't you cry!\pIt's a saying question
that begs your suggestion!\pIf I win a match, what can I say
in a real cool way?
name: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech11

t:
{STR_VAR_1}\pPerfect! That's what I'll use.
I was right to make you choose!\pAnd now, I think it'd be best,
if I were to fly the nest!\pThanks for all you taught me.
I'll be off on a battle spree!\pB-O-N-V-O-Y-A-G-E!
And that spells bon voyage,\lto you this is my homage!
name: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks11

t:
Oh, yeah, {PLAYER}!
I found you again today!\pWhat should I do? Ask you again?
Why not? I'm already asking you!\pAnyways, {PLAYER}…
Are you receiving me?\lYou are receiving me!\lI need some more advice for me!\pIt's about what I should yell.
Something cool to holler when\la battle ends well.\pCome on, I wanna hear you say it!
name: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech12

t:
{STR_VAR_1}\pAll right, all right!
I'll use that because it's so tight!\pI'm out of things to ask you.
Waving bye is all that's left to do.\pBut maybe one day we'll meet, with one
destined to go down in defeat.\pBut, it really is time to say farewell.\pWell, {PLAYER}, I have to roam free,
but don't you forget about me!\pTake care, {PLAYER}!
Love ya!
name: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12

t:
{PLAYER}{KUN}, I'm finished…
My nose won't stop dripping…\pI was trying to think up something
cool to say when I win a battle.\pIt inspired me so much, it made me cry,
and now my nose won't stop running…\pSo, things being this way,
I need you to decide for me, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pWhen I win a battle,
what should I say?
name: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech13

t:
{STR_VAR_1}\p… … …That's good.
No, it's awe inspiring!\lIt's bringing fresh tears to my eyes!\pBut in spite of my tears and runny
nose, I will use that saying!\pI'm plumb out of things to ask you,
{PLAYER}{KUN}.\pFrom now on, we're rivals!
Thanks for everything!
name: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks13

t:
Er… Um…
{PLAYER}{KUN}…\pPlease, don't look at me that way.
You're making me all nervous.\pI… I need your advice again.
I'll make it my last, though…\pIt's really embarrassing to ask,
but what if I win a battle?\lWhat should I say?
name: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech14

t:
{STR_VAR_1}\pOh… Okay!
I'll try to say that!\lI might be too nervous to say it…\pThank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
I have to say good-bye now.\pI'll obey all that you've taught me,
{PLAYER}{KUN}, and do the best I can.
name: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks14

t:
Hm? You appear to be {PLAYER}{KUN}…
But are you really?\lPerhaps a clever {PLAYER} Doll?\pOh, no, no, no, don't worry!
If you really are real, please\lforget about my rudeness.\pNo need to be so angry. All I wish for
is more of your fine advice.\pIt concerns a saying.\pMore precisely, what should I say
if I win a battle?
name: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech15

t:
{STR_VAR_1}\p… … … … … …
When I win a match…\p{STR_VAR_1}\p…Are you serious?\pI see. If you are serious, that's fine.
I thank you for your time.\pI do hope even I will be able to
put that saying to good use.\pI seem to have run dry on what advice
I need.\pI do believe it's high time I bid you
farewell and strike out on my own.\pThank you, my mentor!
I apologize for my skepticism!
name: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15

t:
In the Fallarbor Battle Tent,
we undertake the Set KO Tourney.\pAll participants enter with a team of
three Pokémon.\pThe three Pokémon must be lined up
in the order that they are to appear in.\pDuring battle, the Pokémon will appear
one at a time in the preset order.\pOnce a Pokémon enters battle, it must
remain out until the match is decided.\pIf a match remains undecided in
three turns, it goes to judging.\pIf you wish to interrupt your challenge,
please save the game.\pIf you don't save, you will not be able
to continue with your challenge.\pIf you pull off the feat of beating
three Trainers in succession,\lwe will present you with a fine prize.

In the Verdanturf Battle Tent,
there is one crucial rule that must\lbe obeyed.\pTrainers are permitted only to switch
their Pokémon in and out.\pTrainers are otherwise forbidden to
command their Pokémon.\pThe Pokémon are to behave according
to their nature and battle on their own.\pYou must put your trust in your
Pokémon and watch over them.\pIf you achieve the honor of beating
three Trainers in succession,\lwe will present you with a prize.\pIf you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.\pIf you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.

t: Here at the Verdanturf Battle Tent,\nPokémon are required to think and\lbattle by themselves.\pUnlike in the wild, Pokémon that live\nwith people behave differently\ldepending on their nature.
name: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules

t:
Depending on its nature, a Pokémon
may prefer to attack no matter what.\pAnother Pokémon may prefer to protect
itself from any harm.\pYet another may enjoy vexing or
confounding its foes.\pDepending on its nature, a Pokémon
will have favorite moves that it is good\lat using.\pIt may also dislike certain moves that
it has trouble using.
name: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules

t:
There are offensive moves that inflict
direct damage on the foe.\pThere are defensive moves that are
used to prepare for enemy attacks or\lused to heal HP and so on.\pThere are also other somewhat-odd
moves that may enfeeble the foes with\lstat problems including poison and \lparalysis.\pPokémon will consider using moves in
these three categories.
name: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMoveRules

t:
When not under command by its Trainer,
a Pokémon may be unable to effectively\luse certain moves.\pA Pokémon is not good at using any
move that it dislikes.\pIf a Pokémon only knows moves that
do not match its nature, it will often\lbe unable to live up to its potential.
name: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainUnderpoweredRules

t: Depending on its nature, a Pokémon may\nstart using moves that don't match its\lnature when it is in trouble.\pIf a Pokémon begins behaving oddly\nin a pinch, watch it carefully.
name: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainWhenInDangerRules

t: Mimic is a move of great depth.\pCould you execute it to perfection\nas well as me…?
name: MoveTutor_Text_MimicTaught

t:

lovably admirable.\pBut that also means I have many
rivals for his attention.\pHe's got appeal with a Double-Edge.
I couldn't even catch his eye.\pPlease, let me teach your Pokémon
the move Double-Edge!
name: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTeach

name: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeDeclined

t: I won't live for love anymore!\nI'll become tough!

fast in the sticks like this forever.\pYou watch me, I'll get out to the city
and become a huge hit.\pSeriously, I'm going to cause
a huge Explosion of popularity!\pIf you overheard that, I'll happily
teach Explosion to your Pokémon!
